True unique in-stock count = 95.

corrections.liveMethod: Coverage set-diff: bare #content slug set vs union of all 12 dept #content slug sets. Plus fetched category.php?parent=Import_/_Export.
corrections.evidence: bareContentUnique=95, deptUnionUnique=95, orphans_in_bare_not_dept=0, in_dept_not_bare=0 -> bare and the dept-union cover the IDENTICAL 95 products today. The bare /product.php is a 100%-coverage single URL. The 8-dept spine is redundant AND harmful: (a) departments=Firearms == bare (aggregate alias / unknown-dept fallback, not a peer dept); (b) Knives/Custom_Engraving render 0 products (empty depts, not AJAX-blocked — they 200 with empty #content); (c) category.php?parent=Import_/_Export returns 0 product anchors (it is a sub-category NAVIGATION page, matching DB note 'subcategory.php?parent=Firearms is a navigation/landing page'). DB single-URL catalogUrls=['/product.php'] is correct.

corrections.liveMethod: Fetched ?page=2 and compared #content slug set vs page 1; read jPages config from DB notes; traced runtime pagination use.
corrections.evidence: ?page=2 returns the SAME 95 slugs as page 1 (sameAsPage1=true, same first slug) -> server returns the ENTIRE catalog in one response; ?page param is inert; jPages slices client-side at 12/page for display ONLY. The 12 is a UI display slice, NOT a server pagination unit. The runtime perPage is a crawler-control sentinel (paginationPattern=null so the crawler never requests a next page); DB's perPage:100 ceiling is correct. R1-BLIND's 12 confuses the UI render-slice with the crawler sentinel.

The 2026-04-07 DB cross-reference baseline product (Rifles first slug 'glenfield-model-a-moss-green-308-win-...') has ROTATED OUT of inventory (today Rifles first slug = 'ruger-american-predator-gen-ii-30-06-...'), so the exact old slug cannot be re-matched. The only proof of p.id DESC is the prior product_filter.php POST cross-reference, which this round is forbidden to re-run. CIRCUMSTANTIAL support: the historically-utility items (ATF permit, colt-9mm-bcg, colt-hydr-buffer, xpedition-crossbow) cluster at the END of DOM order, consistent with oldest-last — but this is NOT a proof.
corrections.proposedValue: INCONCLUSIVE — cannot independently re-confirm p.id DESC in R2 under the no-SQL-endpoint constraint. Carry DB's navigate-from-watermark (2026-04-07 cross-reference) forward as UNVERIFIED-this-round. codeFindings.detail: Live selector probe: ALL Phase-1 card SELECTORS match 0 elements on irunguns /product.php (cards are bare <li> with <a class='notapplyloader'> + <div class='primg'>; no data-product-id, no .product/.card class). Therefore extraction falls to Phase-2 link-based fallback (line 1106, fires only when products.length===0). Phase-2 isProductLink regex (line 1125-1127) explicitly matches 'product_detail|product\.php' and '.php', so every product_detail.php?p=<slug> anchor qualifies. Page-wide there are 190 product_detail anchors (each product wrapped twice: image-anchor + title-anchor); Phase-2 de-dupes by full URL via the `seen` set -> 95 unique products extracted. This equals the live bare count exactly. CONCLUSION: the GenericRetailAdapter DOES extract ALL departments' in-stock products from a SINGLE GET of bare /product.php, because the server renders the entire in-stock catalog into #content in one response. No per-department fetching needed; the DB single /product.php catalogUrl is the correct and complete surface.

isNavUrl() rejects category/collections/cart/account/content.php/search.php/etc. but does NOT match 'product_detail.php' or bare 'product.php?p=' -> irunguns product links survive the nav filter in Phase-2 (line 1122). No false-rejection risk.

codeFindings.detail: Read-only confirmation (NO POST sent): page JS contains `formData.append("sql", sql); $.ajax({type:'post', url:'product_filter.php', data:formData, ...})`. A client-controlled `sql` FormData field is posted to product_filter.php. The raw SELECT is built dynamically (not a static literal in homepage HTML). Endpoint NOT probed/exploited per constraint. Crawler does NOT use this endpoint (GET path returns the full catalog; playbook Mistake 16). Flagged for security-engineer review only.
